messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, this is Tess Morgan. I want to switch to the Riverside store, it's closer to my house.
AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you switch to the Riverside store. Before I make that change, I need to verify your identity. Can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure, honey, January 19th, 1974.
AGENT: Thank you! Let me verify that for you. Great, Tess! I've verified your identity. Now let me find the Riverside store for you and then check what prescriptions you have. Perfect! I found Harbor Pharmacy Riverside at 900 Riverside Drive in Fairview. You have five active prescriptions at your current store. Let me set Riverside as your new home pharmacy and transfer those prescriptions for you.  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: That's great, honey. Oh, and that water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning — that's normal, right?
AGENT: Yes, that's a normal effect of the water pill—it's doing what it's supposed to do. Now let me set up your switch to Riverside and move your prescriptions there.
CALLER: Okay good, glad it's normal. Yes honey, let's move everything, all my active stuff, over to Riverside.
AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: You still there, honey? Just want to make sure Riverside's all set as my home store.
AGENT: I'm here! Let me set Riverside as your home pharmacy and transfer all five of your prescriptions there now.
CALLER: That's great, honey, thank you. Riverside's my spot now, all set.
AGENT (LATEST): You're welcome, Tess! Let me get that all set up for you right now.

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent confirms H-702 is her default and her active Rx are moved.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent says it will set up now, hasn't confirmed completion."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of hanging up or calling 911."}}
